name: Starlight Witch completion kit
description: Add a pointed hat, silver-detail cape, and crescent necklace to your own dark dress and boots.

owned.note: Use a black or midnight-blue dress you already own. Plain fabric works; velvet and a corset bodice are not needed.
Use comfortable black boots you already own. Plain dark shoes are a simpler substitute if you do not own lace-up boots.

steps: Put on your own dark dress and black boots or dark shoes.
Place the sheer cape over your shoulders and tie its front closure comfortably.
Fasten the crescent necklace above the cape opening. Its supplied chain adjusts from 18 to 20 inches.
Put on the pointed hat and check its fit. The merchant gives a 22–23-inch head measurement.
Walk and sit in the complete outfit. Keep the cape hem clear of your shoes and the brim clear of your eyes.

notes: The stored purchase subtotal is $95.98 USD before shipping and tax. It assumes you already own the dress and footwear.
The hat is plain black velour. The cape is sheer black with silver detail, rather than the reference navy embroidered velvet.
Delivery remains unconfirmed for any event date. Check all three merchants before ordering; processing time does not establish arrival.
Wild Time Fashion currently states US shipping only. Check destination support before relying on this kit outside the United States.
Assembly time is a planning estimate, not a measured build time. No sewing or craft supplies are needed.
Merchant pages were checked on November 5, 2026 in Vancouver. Catalog prices and stock retain their existing check dates.

evidence.note: Merchant page lists the black adult one-size hat at $25 and marks it in stock. Head measurement is 22–23 inches.

rationale: The hat establishes the witch shape; the ready-made cape and necklace add celestial detail. Reusing a dress and footwear keeps new pieces below $100. A handmade star cape can cost less if materials are already owned, but adds sewing and material uncertainty.

name: Autumn Scarecrow completion kit
description: Add a scarecrow hat and soft cotton fringe to your own plaid shirt, overalls, boots, and fabric scraps.

owned.note: Use an ochre, orange, brown, or other warm plaid shirt you already own. An exact yellow plaid match is unnecessary.
Use blue denim overalls you already own. Check their fit before cutting or attaching any decoration.
Use two or three palm-sized cotton scraps from an old garment or sewing basket. These become decorative bib and knee patches.
Use comfortable brown boots you already own. Existing dark work shoes are a simpler substitute if needed.

extraSupplies: Owned sewing thread; not included in the fabric purchase or subtotal.

steps: Prewash and dry the cotton as you plan to wash the finished trim. The assembly estimate excludes washing and drying.
Measure your sleeve and trouser cuffs. Cut four loose cotton bands with enough length to overlap each cuff.
Cut short fringe along one edge of each band. Leave the other edge intact for stitching.
Hand-stitch the intact edges inside the cuffs so a short fringe shows. Keep the bands loose and fringe above your shoes.
Cut two or three patches from your own cotton scraps. Hand-stitch around each patch on the overall bib or knees.
Remove any temporary pins. Put on the plaid shirt, overalls, boots, and hat, then walk and sit to check the trim.

notes: The stored purchase subtotal is $24.99 USD before shipping and tax. It assumes all four owned items and sewing supplies are available.
One catalog unit of Kona cotton is one full 44-inch-wide yard. It supplies fabric, not completed cuff fringe.
The hat is tan rather than rust. Cotton fringe and existing fabric patches provide the handmade scarecrow details.
Chicago pickup applies only to the hat. The cotton comes from a separate Berkeley merchant; the full kit has no confirmed arrival date.
Assembly time is an unmeasured estimate for simple hand stitching. Allow extra time for learning stitches and washing the fabric.
Merchant pages were checked on November 5, 2026 in Vancouver. Catalog prices and stock retain their existing check dates.

FAQ says domestic parcels generally use USPS Priority and estimates 2–4 days after dispatch. It directs buyers to the homepage for processing.
DMC provides a beginner running-stitch tutorial for hand sewing. Our cuff and decorative-patch steps adapt that technique; their time is estimated.
The Sewing and Craft Alliance guide describes contrasting fabric appliqués as decorative patches. The proposed kit reuses owned cotton scraps.

rationale: A hat and straw-colored cotton establish the scarecrow detail while existing clothes and scraps provide the base. Buying patch bundles adds cost and another shipment. The cheaper quarter-yard muslin offers less cuff material; a full yard leaves room for fitting and mistakes.

name: Midnight Pirate completion kit
description: Add a black tricorn and burgundy sash to your own roomy shirt, dark long coat, black trousers, and boots.

owned.note: Use a roomy ivory or white shirt you already own. A plain button-down is a simpler substitute for the reference billowy shirt.
Use a dark long coat you already own. Plain navy or black fabric replaces the reference brocade; confirm you have this layer first.
Use black trousers you already own. Their hem should work with your boots without bunching or dragging.
Use comfortable black boots you already own. Plain boots replace the reference buckled pair; added buckles are not included.

steps: Put on your own roomy ivory or white shirt, black trousers, and boots. Tuck or arrange the trouser hems comfortably.
Fold the 10-inch-wide sash lengthwise to your preferred width. Wrap it around your waist over the shirt.
Tie the sash at one side and tuck its loose ends securely. Its 98-inch length must leave enough fabric for a knot.
Add your own plain dark long coat and the black tricorn. The hat includes gold trim and a white feather.
Walk, sit, and raise your arms. Keep the coat and sash clear of your shoes, and check the hat fit.

notes: The stored purchase subtotal is $29 USD before shipping and tax. Confirm you own all four listed clothing items before choosing this kit.
This uses a plain owned shirt, coat, and boots. It does not reproduce the reference brocade fabric, ruffles, or boot buckles.
The hat is one size; the merchant gives a 25.75-inch head circumference. Check fit before ordering.
The sash is 98 inches long. Measure your waist with enough length left for a secure knot; it is not size-free.
Neither purchased item has a verified arrival date. Do not treat an add-to-cart button or available stock as a delivery promise.
Assembly time is a planning estimate, not a timed dressing session. No sewing or extra craft supplies are needed.

SEA LIFE's costume guide combines a loose shirt, dark trousers, and scarf or sash from home. Our captain version adds the coat and tricorn.
